g.text: Five dyads, 185 bp apart. Each dyad contributes 1 at one genomic base; all other values are 0.
This 925 bp unmasked region has 925 − d possible position pairs. Zero-signal bases still count.
In this constructed example, all four normalized peaks equal 1/185 ≈ 0.00541.
